facts.fact: The WHO Algeria office reports that the Ministry of Health, so that the national health information system yields information for decision-makers at every level, began with WHO support training health practitioners and IT staff to use the DHIS2 platform adapted to the national context: a first five-day session in December 2023 for a first team of 20, led by an international expert, with further sessions to be programmed in the 2024-2025 work plan.

The WHO Algeria office reports that the national digital health strategy, under which the DHIS2 training was begun, was still a draft in November 2023: a pre-validation workshop of sixty participants enriched the initial draft ahead of its submission to the national authorities for validation, so no adopted strategy is stated.
